## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (56%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Image sits at the 100th OOD percentile, and in situ stays in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 56%, InSitu 23%, Benign 20%, Invasive <1% | Normal leads; InSitu second |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90%) | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 100th percentile | Flagged; atypical image [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal [F5] | Mostly supports Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 2, 6) · context · Above-typical TIL score; descriptive only · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · Top of the reference range [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Typical score; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells within ducts** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; associated with higher invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion drop of 0.54 logit versus random (CI 0.47 to 0.60) excludes 0; faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Lymphocytes Weak (8/20); mitoses Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- The image is out of distribution, so the probabilities may not transfer.
- The second model (MUSK) picks a different top class.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 6:** Verify the lymphocytic infiltrate; its spot check was weak.
2. **Region 0:** Look for atypical cells confined within ducts, since in situ is in the set.
3. **Region 8:** Check the stroma for tumor infiltration, the top region for that concept.
